PROP-e5782b58-inv-018.text: New user registration must set role/permission_level to 0 (regular member), never admin by default.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-018.assertion: forall completeRegistration: new_user.permission_level == 0 AND new_user.is_admin == false

locations.note: Inserts new member with is_admin: false hardcoded at line 289; no caller can override this field during registration
